plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Music, General A.A. Degree - CalGETC' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8014/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 69; verified = 18+18+16+17 = 69 (all semester headers match their rows). MUIVI 410 Applied Music (1 unit) is genuinely repeated in all 4 semesters per the map's explicit footnote ('Students must enroll in MUIVI 410 each semester for 4 semesters'); auditions take place the first week of classes to enter MUIVI 410. allow_repeated_courses is true and documented here. MUIVI 410 co-requisites per map: the semester's theory course (MUFHL 400/404/412/414) plus one large performing ensemble selected from any MUP course. MUFHL 405 lists MUFHL 402 & 403 as prerequisites; those courses are not sequenced in the map (the map sequences the combined MUFHL 400 instead) and are carried under external_prereqs. MUFHL 310 carries GE AREA 'CRC Area L3' (apparent typo in a CalGETC map); encoded as a major course. Semester 3 includes one 3-unit course the map describes as meeting both Cal-GETC Area 4 (Social & Behavioral Sciences) and 'Area VI-Ethnic/Multicultural Studies' (old CRC GE terminology); encoded as Area 4 per the GE AREA column. List A (large ensembles, minimum 8 units): MUP 310/311/320/321/330/331/353/357/360/424 — 2 units sequenced in each semester (8 total); a different course per slot. Advisories are recommendations only, recorded in choice_notes, never as prereqs. CalGETC Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
